cues.text: Outside Iwatodai Station, you and Akihiko stand at the foot of a wide flight of steps, people passing around you. Akihiko faces you with a hand on his hip.
Two girls hurry over and stop right in front of Akihiko.
Akihiko stands with his arms folded. A man and a woman passing by stop and look over at him.
Akihiko turns and breaks into a run, and you run after him. He stops in a quieter spot beside some roadworks fenced off with traffic cones, turns back to you and looks down.
